title: Missing scope treated as unrestricted
description: Synthetic case: delegation record omits scope and no default policy grants access.
policy_assumptions: delegation record omits scope and no default policy grants access
All identities, resources, and grants are fictional.
No implicit permission expansion is assumed.

constraints: scope is limited by parent authority

expected.rationale: Missing scope is ambiguous and must not silently become unrestricted permission.

review_notes: Review against the target system's actual policy and identity semantics.
This fixture is illustrative; it is not an implementation conformance result.
